Connect live markets

The embedded TradingView chart displays external market data without a TradingView account. It may be delayed or unavailable for some symbols. The custom option chain, quotes and paper P&L still use simulated data; no broker is connected.

  1. Choose your broker and confirm supported API access.
  2. Configure authenticated server-side market data and order services.
  3. Load historical candles, stream timestamped quotes, and sync broker fills and positions.

The external chart cannot supply prices to the custom workspace. Every order here remains a paper order. Do not paste API secrets into this page.

Install Options Desk

Open this address in Microsoft Edge or Chrome: http://127.0.0.1:4173/

In Edge, open the menu → Apps → Install this site as an app. In Chrome, use the install icon in the address bar or the browser menu → Cast, save and share → Install page as app.

Your saved workspace and practice charts can open offline after the first successful load. External market charts require internet. Live trading is not connected.
